name: Water Resources Systems
description: Water resources planning purposes and objectives; multi-component, multi-user, multi-objective and multi-purpose attributes of an integrated water resources system; economic principles for evaluating alternative plans including benefit-cost analysis; reservoir sizing and design; environmental and water quality aspects of river basin management; structural flood control alternatives and estimation of storage capacities; multi-objective and multi-criteria decision-making in water resources planning; application of linear, dynamic, and integer programming in capacity expansion and system optimization; deterministic and stochastic models for multi-purpose river basin planning and management; simulation-based multi-goal modeling approaches for water management; irrigation planning and operation models including conjunctive use of surface and groundwater; modern tools and decision support systems for reservoir operation, canal management, hydropower scheduling, flood control, and sediment management; uncertainty in water resources management planning.
